title: Observation
description: An observation. Class-level properties describe the observation type/modality. Instance-level properties describe a concrete perceived event at a specific time.

run_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the run this observation belongs to.

agent_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the agent that made the observation.

timestamp_s.description: [instance-level] Simulated time in seconds when the observation occurred.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the observation record format.

target_instance_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the observed object instance, if any.

target_type_id.description: [class-level] Identifier of the observed object's type, if known.

properties.description: [instance-level] Observed attribute values (color, size, temperature, etc.) as key/value pairs.

confidence.description: [instance-level] Agent's confidence in this observation (0 to 1).
